tools.name: get_specs
tools.description:
Read canonical extracted specs (min/typ/max, unit, conditions) for known
IC part numbers from a pre-extracted parametric index — not from datasheet text.
This is the cheapest and most precise source for numeric parameters where it has

tools.name: compare_parts
tools.description:
Relative price tier, stock posture, and library class for a set of IC part
numbers (a ranking from a distributor snapshot, not a live quote).

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search the datasheet corpus; returns hit records (metadata + snippet, each
with an opaque `ref`). Pass a ref list to `get_segments` for full content.
If you already know the part number(s), prefer `lookup` — it fuses this search
with `get_segments` in one call and groups full content per part. Use `

tools.name: lookup
tools.description:
One-shot spec/section retrieval: full content of the most relevant datasheet
segments for one or more parts (fuses search+get_segments). Already groups results per
part (via `parts`), so prefer `lookup` over `search` when you know the part(s).

tools.name: get_segments
tools.description:
Expand opaque `ref` tokens (from search/lookup) into full datasheet segment
content.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description:
Fetch datasheet figure images (PNG/JPEG) for opaque `ref` tokens obtained
from search/lookup/get_segments. Returns each image plus its caption/description/page
metadata. Only `type='image'` segments have image data; a ref that is not one comes

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "find_parts" is 2011 chars, far longer than this server's median (373). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Shortlist IC part numbers by parametric spec constraints, ranked by how many constraints each part satisfies, then by headroom past those thresholds, and spread…

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_parts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
